lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits, displaying regular inter-blob spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature running horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow-casting on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense, labyrinthine patterning of small circular blobs on the head and the proximal surface of the pectoral fin. Light caustic patterns from surface refraction are visible across the dorsal midline.
